gloss: to remove; to eliminate; to get rid of

definitions.gloss: to remove; to eliminate; to get rid of
definitions.explanation: To take away something unwanted or harmful. Commonly used for removing contaminants, obstacles, stains, or undesirable elements.

examples.japanese: ⟦{汚|よご}れ→汚れ：03186_yogore⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{除去|じょきょ}する。
⟦{不純物|ふじゅんぶつ}→不純物：15163_fujunbutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{除去|じょきょ}する⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: It is necessary to remove the impurities.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{装置|そうち}→装置：03318_souchi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{空気中|くうきちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{有害|ゆうがい}{物質|ぶっしつ}→有害物質：22132_yuugaibusshitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{除去|じょきょ}すること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: This device can remove harmful substances from the air.

notes:
Focuses on removing something unwanted or harmful to restore a clean or safe state. The thing being removed is typically something negative: dirt, contaminants, obstacles, or hazards.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{汚|よご}れ→汚れ：03186_yogore⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{除去|じょきょ}する: to remove dirt/stains
- ⟦{不純物|ふじゅんぶつ}→不純物：15163_fujunbutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{除去|じょきょ}する: to remove impurities
- ⟦{障害|しょうがい}→障害：03228_shougai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{除去|じょきょ}する: to remove obstacles
- ⟦{地雷|じらい}→地雷：22476_jirai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{除去|じょきょ}する: to clear landmines
- ⟦{除去|じょきょ}→除去：14567_jokyo⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧: removal work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{取|と}り{除|のぞ}く→取り除く：04222_torinozoku⟧: to remove — everyday equivalent, less formal
- ⟦{排除|はいじょ}→排除：07631_haijo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to exclude / to eliminate — stronger nuance of forcefully driving out; often used for people or abstract threats
- ⟦{撤去|てっきょ}する→撤去する：21321_tekkyosuru⟧: to remove / to dismantle — specifically for removing installed structures or equipment
- ⟦{削除|さくじょ}→削除：04171_sakujo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to delete — specifically for removing data, text, or digital content

REGISTER:
Formal. Common in technical, scientific, and official contexts. In everyday speech, ⟦{取|と}り{除|のぞ}く→取り除く：04222_torinozoku⟧ or ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ are more natural.
